significance: First male rap-delivery vocal material available to the project. Every prior real-vocal result used three solo-singing fixtures, two explicitly female, none rap.
critical_finding: The 'RawTune' filename is not reliable. These are neither uniformly raw nor uniformly tuned. All five are loudness-normalized, and pitch correction is baked into three of them to materially different degrees. Treat each take individually; do not batch them as 'raw'.

common_properties.mono_evidence: L/R correlation = 1.000000 on all five; MoveWrong is bit-identical between channels, the rest differ by 4e-13 to 8e-3. Mono content in a stereo container.
common_properties.normalization_evidence: Integrated loudness -11.22 to -12.15 LUFS with peaks parked at -0.32 to -0.54 dBFS across five separately-produced files. That ceiling consistency is normalization or limiting, not a raw capture.
common_properties.consequence: These cannot serve as loudness references — the same trap as the social-media clips. They are usable as processing inputs provided A/B renders are loudness-matched.
